pages.notes: Military UFO incident report form with dark microfilm scan. OCR has significant errors: title shows 'CEECK*LIST' instead of 'CHECK-LIST', number of objects misread as '4' instead of '1', 'Over 5 minutes' as 'Oye 5 mimes', and field 24 completely garbled ('spcebebeseptee'). Structure preserved but character substitution errors throughout.

Photocopied declassified document with clear typewritten text and RESTRICTED stamps; OCR captured fragmented content but with numerous character substitutions, missing words, and garbled sequences making it significantly degraded despite the readable source material.

Government UFO incident report form with multiple character-level OCR errors: names misread (Buser→Hmser, Smith→Saith), abbreviations consistently wrong (M/S read as a/s, u/s, 4/8, B/S), and word corruptions (Not→Wot, Could→Gould, towards→towerds), though overall document structure and most content captured.
Declassified typewritten UAP report with clear readability; OCR heavily corrupted with character substitutions and fragmentation—captured only ~30% of visible text content.

Typewritten government UFO incident checklist form; OCR begins with ~25 lines of garbled characters, then captures form structure but with systematic errors (obsorvor/observer, dotectod/detected, Incidont/Incident, arC/ATC). CONFIDENTIAL stamps visible at top and bottom.
Page contains clear centered typewritten text about a UAP sighting near Mt. Tom, but OCR output is completely garbled nonsense bearing no resemblance to actual content.

UFO incident checklist form with typewritten entries; OCR completely fails on line numbers at top, struggles with coordinates (128°9.3' E misread as yam'9,3!), timezone abbreviations (PST→PSZ), and special characters due to dark scan and CONFIDENTIAL stamps.

Page contains a full paragraph of typewritten text describing a UFO sighting near Great Falls, Montana in August 1952, but OCR captured no text; extremely dark scan with low contrast and faded text appear to have caused complete OCR failure despite legible content.

UFO incident report form with significant OCR degradation; many n/s (not specified) entries misread as random characters, Color field severely garbled, and numeric entries corrupted (3/S for n/s, ¥ for W); readable to human but OCR struggled with low contrast microfilm scan.

Dark microfilm scan of classified military memo; OCR captures main narrative paragraph but badly corrupts coordinates (38°50' N, 121°05' W), timestamps, and specific numbers; lower half of page increasingly faded and less captured.

Typewritten UFO incident checklist form dated 30 Dec 1947; OCR severely corrupted—missing items 1-7, mangling field descriptions, converting 'N/S' to 'M/S', and losing structural form hierarchy; captures only scattered fragments like altitude values and 'exploded' despite clear typewritten text.

OCR captured the main narrative but made critical errors on coordinates (39° 53' N, 118° 53' W became garbled), place names (Lovelock, Nevada heavily corrupted), and several words (obtained→dbtained, appear→appecr, approximately→tagurecteiely). Dark microfilm scan with low contrast degrades accuracy on numbers and proper nouns.

Government UFO incident report form with significant OCR errors: garbled header section, repeated character misidentification (Dee→Dec, Plight→Flight, Effoct→Effect, disappearance→disappoarance), and missing RESTRICTED stamp; form structure and field labels mostly captured but reliability is low.

Typewritten memo with RESTRICTED stamps; actual text is clearly readable but OCR severely mangled most words (e.g., 'Fairfield' → 'Feirficla', 'from' → 'Fon', '1925' → '1525', 'incidents' → 'salokaalz'), with extra line breaks and character corruption suggesting typeface recognition failure.

Form captures UFO incident checklist but OCR has numerous single-character substitutions (obsorvor→observer, kaxge→large, eerthward→earthward, Woathor→Weather, etc.) and garbled line numbers at the start; overall content is recoverable but error rate is moderately high.

Microfilm scan of typewritten incident report with scattered OCR errors including misspellings (bresk→break, apreared→appeared, lerge→large, epproximately→approximately, dietance→distance, end→and) and one garbled word (amkemx).

Typewritten RESTRICTED government form capturing overall structure but with numerous systematic OCR errors: Placo→Place, Numbor→Number, obsorver→observer, Vagsa→Vaasa, Shapo→Shape, dotectod→detected, Woathor→Weather, Effoct→Effect, disappoaranco→disappearance, and inconsistent N/S capitalization.

Microfilm scan with significant character-level OCR errors: 'Location'→'Locetion', 'observer'→'obsorvor/observor', 'objects'→'objocs', 'detected'→'dotectea', 'Time'→'Timo'. RESTRICTED stamp and handwritten notes visible; core content recognizable but many substitutions and case inconsistencies.

Mostly blank page with faded CONFIDENTIAL stamps (top and bottom, both struck through for declassification) and faint redacted text at bottom right; OCR correctly identified no recoverable machine-readable text.
